creator_inputs.target_duration_seconds: Agents propose 4-30 seconds for new text/reference projects; creator approves with storyboard. Legacy fixed settings preserved.
creator_inputs.task_type_constraint: Seedance 2.5 edit, extend, first-frame, and first-last-frame tasks require adaptive ratio; editing requires automatic duration

storyboard.source: human creator brief and approved reference media
storyboard.format: Editable shot list with a visual scene card per shot and optional AI-generated preview images
storyboard.preview_policy: Build a scene card from creator-provided references and shot text by default. After the shot list is drafted, creators may generate AI preview images for selected shots or all shots after seeing an estimated cost. Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is a candidate, subject to API access and cost verification. Every generated preview records its source model, inputs, version, and cost. Creators approve, replace, or reject previews before agents use them. Generated previews interpret the brief and never override creator instructions or uploaded references; they are not automatically passed to Seedance as reference assets.
authority_order: human creator brief and explicit must-haves
storyboard.agent_use: Visual and continuity reviewers may inspect approved previews alongside source references to catch framing, identity, prop, and transition conflicts; they must cite which source controls a disputed detail.
storyboard.approval: human creators approve a version before prompt review
storyboard.change_control: agents may propose changes but cannot silently alter an approved version

preview_generation.default: Reference-based scene cards; no automatic image-model call
options: Generate all shot previews after cost estimate
preview_generation.model_status: Candidate only; verify key access, pricing, and quality during implementation
preview_generation.approval: Creator approval required before generated previews influence prompt review

agents.task: Structure creator intent without changing must-haves
Timestamped image/video/audio observations and uncertainty before storyboard
Cross-check selected dense video frames for motion, identity and spatial relations
Artistic direction, dramaturgy, hook, motivated rule breaks and proposed 4-30s duration
Translate approved shots into actionable Seedance instructions and media aliases
Independently check timing, causal clarity, hook and payoff
Source fidelity, framing, camera movement and visual realism
Cinematic sound, speech intelligibility and audiovisual synchronization
Identity, state transitions and continuity; preserve intentional departures
Resolve supported findings and produce concrete repairs before final audit
Independently validate the repaired prompt against original brief, evidence and acceptance criteria

required: valid media and explicit media roles
approval_gate.limits: Default maximum of three review rounds (configurable from two to five), timeout, and cost ceiling; major or critical findings, prompt changes, and linter errors require another review or block approval at the limit
approval_gate.quality_claim: Review cannot guarantee generated video quality

usage_dashboard.method: Capture provider-reported usage for every call and calculate estimates using versioned provider/model rates; count retries and failed calls separately
usage_dashboard.default_budget: To be set after observing initial real reviews

accounts_and_storage.invites: Admins generate one-time, expiring invitation links and send them manually; no outbound email provider is required in the first release
accounts_and_storage.project_visibility: Own projects and explicitly shared projects only
accounts_and_storage.media_storage: Private Docker volume initially; deletion and configurable retention remain pending before public deployment
accounts_and_storage.secrets: API keys server-side only; never commit .env or expose keys to browser clients

security_and_maintenance.priority: Security is a release gate for the invitation-only service and its sensitive media
containers: Multi-stage builds with minimal runtime images and pinned base image versions
Run every application process as a dedicated non-root UID/GID
Read-only root filesystem where practical; explicit writable mounts only for required data and temporary files
Drop Linux capabilities, set no-new-privileges, retain Docker's default seccomp profile, and avoid privileged mode and host networking
Never mount the Docker socket into application containers
Health checks, resource limits, restart policy, and graceful shutdown
Database and worker ports remain internal; expose only the reverse proxy over TLS
application: Invitation-only account creation, secure sessions, role-based project access, and server-side authorization checks
CSRF protection where cookie sessions are used, rate limits for login/invites/uploads/reviews, and audit events
Strict media type and size validation, isolated processing, safe filenames, and no public media URLs by default
Before public deployment, scan uploaded files with an isolated antivirus service and fail closed when scanning is unavailable; antivirus does not replace safe decoding or prompt-injection boundaries
API keys and session secrets injected at runtime, never baked into images, logged, or returned to browsers
Per-review cost and concurrency ceilings to limit accidental API spend

updates.dependency_bot: Weekly Dependabot pull requests for Python, Docker base images, and GitHub Actions; automatic merge is allowed only after required CI jobs pass on the tested head commit
updates.ci_gates: Dependency audit, container vulnerability scan, secret scan, lint, tests, and build before merge
updates.deployment_policy: Build reviewed updates into new immutable images and redeploy with rollback; do not silently upgrade containers on startup
updates.urgent_fixes: Prioritize critical security advisories and document upgrade ownership

security_and_maintenance.verification: Dockerfiles, Compose security settings, access control, and restore/upgrade path must be checked before public deployment

seedance_rules.source_priority: Official BytePlus API and Seedance 2.5 prompt guide and official skill before community templates
seedance_rules.prompt_language: English final prompt by default; German creator UI allowed
seedance_rules.prompt_length_guidance: BytePlus recommends no more than 1000 English words; keep it concise
seedance_rules.prompt_structure: One-sentence summary; ordered shots or continuous timeline; observable actions, camera, audio, and consistent global details
seedance_rules.media_limits: For 2.5 omni reference: up to 30 images, 10 videos totaling at most 30 seconds, and 10 audio clips totaling at most 30 seconds; validate per-file constraints by task type
seedance_rules.reference_contract: Give each asset a stable ID, upload order, purpose, authority, affected shots, and exclusions

model_access.method: Read-only model listing with local API keys
model_access.limitation: Listing visibility does not prove successful inference or sufficient quota

latest_check.method: Read-only provider model listing with local API keys; official model documentation

interface_design.source: https://zoyanywhere.com/ as inspected on 2026-09-29; keep tokens configurable if the site changes
interface_design.style: Use the existing Zoyanywhere visual language for the application, with accessible contrast and clear focus states.

responsive.mobile_layout: Single-column brief, media, storyboard, reviews, and cost views; no horizontal page overflow. Shot details and agent findings open as stacked panels or tabs.
responsive.desktop_layout: Use wider space for a shot timeline, side-by-side reference and preview comparison, agent findings, and cost overview.
responsive.touch_and_accessibility: Touch targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels, keyboard access, visible focus, readable text, sufficient contrast, and accessible status updates.
responsive.workflow_parity: Creators can upload references, inspect and approve previews, review findings, and approve the final prompt on phone and desktop.
responsive.verification: Check representative phone, tablet, and desktop widths in the browser before release; include layout and core workflow tests.

interface_design.design_direction: Modern, polished creator workspace aligned with Zoyanywhere: generous spacing, clear type hierarchy, restrained motion, calm surfaces, strong contrast, and focused orange accents. Show the current step, review status, unresolved findings, and cost without crowding the screen.
interaction_requirements: Keep brief, storyboard, specialist findings, supervisor decision, and approval easy to scan
Distinguish source references from AI-generated previews and show provenance
Make critical blockers and budget warnings prominent without relying on color alone
Use concise progressive disclosure for advanced settings and detailed agent reasoning
Respect reduced-motion preferences and maintain keyboard and screen-reader access

three_dimensional_design.direction: Selective 3D depth within the Zoyanywhere visual style, using charcoal, orange, and warm cream
placements: Optional spatial illustration or layered hero on the signed-in dashboard
Depth and subtle perspective for storyboard shot cards and workflow transitions
Optional interactive 3D view only where it clarifies shot framing or camera movement
constraints: Critical review text, costs, forms, and approval controls remain flat, readable, and accessible
No 3D effect may block the review or approval workflow
Use lightweight assets and lazy-load heavier scenes
Provide a static 2D fallback for mobile, low-power devices, unsupported browsers, and reduced-motion preferences
Respect reduced-motion settings and avoid continuous animation by default
three_dimensional_design.acceptance: Desktop and mobile core workflows remain usable with 3D disabled

seedance_handoff.phase: prompt handoff only; BytePlus generation remains later
seedance_handoff.prompt_aliases: Use @ImageN, @VideoN, and @AudioN in the copyable final prompt; number each media type separately in upload order.
seedance_handoff.reference_files: Show the matching original filename and role under the prompt. The creator uploads the files to the external video studio in that order; names or aliases alone do not attach media.
seedance_handoff.settings: Set duration, aspect ratio, and resolution in separate video-generation controls, not as a prompt header.

quality_first_architecture_plan.status: implemented; automated tests cover workflow, real-video outcome validation pending
quality_first_architecture_plan.objective: A realistic, artistically intentional Seedance video that meets creator requirements on the first generation; optimize total cost per accepted video rather than cost per model call.
quality_first_architecture_plan.evaluation_context: Video project evaluated by professors; not a master thesis. Academic process documentation is not required by this scope.
quality_first_architecture_plan.creative_policy: Film principles guide decisions. Preserve deliberate, motivated departures from realism, continuity, rhythm or perspective. Distinguish creative intent from accidental errors; do not flatten originality into generic advertising.

duration.selected_by: agents propose; creator approves with storyboard
duration.validation: Shot durations sum to selected duration; export as a separate generation setting. This policy targets text/reference generation; other task types retain their provider constraints.
